title: The Vow of Bellbird Bay
author: Bram Eriksen
blurb: Mara Ashgrove, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
